# Veeam ONE Certificates


When you configure Veeam ONE infrastructure, you can specify what TLS certificate must be used to establish a secure connection between Veeam ONE components. Veeam ONE offers the following options for TLS certificates:

* Keep the default self-signed TLS certificate generated by Veeam ONE during installation or upgrade.
* Generate a new self-signed TLS certificate. For more information, see [Generating Self-Signed Certificates](certs_self_signed.md).
* Select an existing TLS certificate from the certificate store. For more information, see [Importing Certificate from Certificate Store](certs_import_from_store.md).
* Import a TLS certificate from a file in the PFX format. For more information, see [Importing Certificate from PFX Files](certs_import_from_file.md).

If you plan to use a certificate issued by your own Certificate Authority (CA), make sure that the certificate meets the requirements. For more information, see [Using Certificate Signed by Internal CA](certs_internal_ca.md).
